profile.headline: Software Engineer II at CAE
profile.summary:
Currently working on developing intelligent agents in an advanced modeling and simulation environment for CAE's R&D department in Arlington, TX.

Latin honors graduate from University of Minnesota - Twin Cities, majoring in Aerospace Engineering & Mechanics,  as well as Computer Science. I am passionate about engineering, software development, and learning new things.
